title: Command builders
description: JSON-driven command generators on docsite pages — how to add segments, fields, and presets without React changes.

blocks.text: Command builders render the Quick commands + Build custom command UI on docsite pages. Maintainers configure them entirely in JSON: field definitions, option lists, presets, wizard steps, and per-page placement. Template generation builders live in templates-registry.json; all other segments use content/shared/command-builders-registry.json.

blocks.title: Full maintainer guide
blocks.text: See docsite/COMMAND_BUILDERS.md in the repo for step-by-step examples: adding a new builder segment, new field keys, option sets, and wiring a page block.

rows: tempjs hotel — generate, theme, brand, database
tempjs real-estate — generate + RERA brand fields

blocks.text: Show a builder on a page

Add a command-builder block to any page JSON under docsite/content/. For segment builders, set builderId to a key from command-builders-registry.json. On template pages, omit builderId to use the template entry from templates-registry.json.

rows: Segment builders: presets, modes, wizardSteps, fieldKeys
Reusable field defs: flags, toggles, positional args

items: Add field keys to command-builder-fields.json if you need new flags or positional args
Add option sets to command-builder-options.json if fields use type select/arg with optionSet
Add an entry under builders in command-builders-registry.json with presets, modes, wizardSteps
Insert a command-builder block with builderId on the target page JSON
No React changes required unless you need a new field type or option set shape
